Complete and hand in your work

  1. Close lesson practice and model answers before starting your assessed work. Read the complete instruction in each task.
  2. Write your own responses in your Biology PSA document or on paper. Use clear headings for 1(g), 1(h) and 1(i). The task pages display the instructions and figures. Write and save your answers separately.
  3. Include clear, readable scans or photos if you have written or drawn on paper for a digital submission. Check that all three sections are included and your files open.
  4. Hand in all three sections through your usual school submission route by Friday 27 November 2026. Ask your teacher if you need the submission destination or a release code.

Work independently. Use only resources your teacher has authorised. Do not use AI or share your answers. Cite sources using Harvard referencing and complete the required authentication.
